interface.name: zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1
interface.description:
The purpose of this protocol is to enable the creation of taskbars and docks by providing them with a list of opened applications and letting them request certain actions on them, like maximizing, etc.
After a client binds the zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1, each opened toplevel window will send a toplevel event with a zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 object.

event.name: toplevel
event.description: This event is emitted whenever a new toplevel window is created. It is immediately followed by a series of initial properties (title, app_id, states, etc.) and a done event.

request.name: stop
request.description:
Indicates the client no longer wishes to receive events for new toplevels. However the compositor may emit toplevel_created events, until the finished event is emitted.
The client must not send any more requests after this one.

event.name: finished

description.summary: the compositor has finished with the toplevel_manager

event.description: This event indicates that the compositor is done with this toplevel_manager. The client should destroy the zwlr_foreign_toplevel_manager_v1 object.

interface.name: zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1
interface.description: A zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 object represents an opened toplevel window. A series of initial events will be emitted after the zwlr_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 object is created, which will describe the toplevel's properties.

event.name: title
event.description: This event is emitted when the title of the toplevel changes.

event.name: app_id
event.description: This event is emitted when the app-id of the toplevel changes.

event.name: output_enter
event.description: This event is emitted when the toplevel enters an output.

event.name: output_leave
event.description: This event is emitted when the toplevel leaves an output.

enum.name: state

description.summary: types of states on the toplevel

enum.description: The different states that a toplevel can have. These have the same meaning as the states with the same names defined in xdg-toplevel

event.name: state
event.description: This event is emitted when the toplevel changes its state.

event.name: done

description.summary: all information about the toplevel has been sent

event.description: This event is sent after all changes in the toplevel state have been sent.

event.name: closed
event.description: This event is emitted when the toplevel is closed. The client should destroy the object.

description.summary: requests that the toplevel be maximized
requests that the toplevel be unmaximized
requests that the toplevel be minimized
requests that the toplevel be unminimized

request.name: activate
request.description: Request that this toplevel be activated on the given seat.

description.summary: request that the toplevel be closed

request.name: set_rectangle

description.summary: the rectangle which represents the toplevel

request.description: The minimum size of the rectangle is 0x0.

description.summary: request that the toplevel be made fullscreen
request that the toplevel be made not fullscreen

event.name: parent
event.description: This event is emitted when the parent of the toplevel changes.
